title: Valid Anagram
summary: Given strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s.
approach: Count characters of s, decrement for t; all counts must end at zero. Lengths must match.
complexity: O(n) time, O(k) space for k distinct characters
body: Follow-up for Unicode: Swift `Character` already handles grapheme clusters, so emoji and accents compare correctly.
